s: Shiur hadas vaaraba ubo b' seipim: shiur orek badde hadas vaaraba — en pachot mishshelosha tepachim shehem y"b gudalin, veshidro shel hallulab — en pachot mearbaa tepachim, kede sheyyihyeh shidro shel lulab yotze lemala mehahadas vaaraba tepach kede ninua, shettepach zeh hayyotze lemala mehaagudda (perush shelosha minim ellu beyachad niqra agudda) hu hamnaanea, vetepach zeh tzarik sheyyehe mehashshidra atzmah, lebad min healin haarukkim hayyotzeim lemala leachar shekkolta hashshidra. Veyesh omerim shettepachim ellu hen qetannim sheen bekol tepach raq shelosha gudalin ushelish, venimtza sheshshelosha tepachim en bahem raq asara gudalin, vehallulab y"g gudalin ushelish. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bishat haddechaq. Veken bediabad shekkebar berak al agudda sheen bah raq keshiur zeh — yatza, veen tzarik lachazor ulebarek, ella yittol minim kesherim belo beraka:
Lemala — en lahem shiur, sheim rotzeh lehosip al shiuran — hareshut beyado lehosip kamma sheyyirtzeh, ubilbad sheyyehe shidro shel lulab yotze lemala mehaagudda tepach kede ninuo:
